title: Put AI to work on your portfolio. Never give it your broker password.
excerpt: One console for every brokerage and HoldCo. Deterministic risk, tax, and FX rules check every order before 1-tap Touch ID execution.
content_html:
ClearFills: Agentic Wealth & Execution OS.

Deterministic Ed25519 pre-trade risk firewall, unified multi-entity net worth command center, OAuth 2.1 Remote MCP, Touch ID WebAuthn passkey approvals, standing mandates, and multi-venue execution (IBKR, Alpaca, Polymarket, Kalshi). AI agents never hold brokerage credentials.

Deterministic Pre-Trade Risk Invariants (Zero LLM in the Loop)

  • MARKET_ORDER_FORBIDDEN: Strict limit orders only.
  • MISSING_HARD_STOP: Atomic bracket stop-loss or bounded binary collateral required.
  • MAX_TRADE_RISK_EXCEEDED: ≤ 1.5% NLV equities risk / ≤ 1.0% fractional Kelly on Polymarket & Kalshi.
  • MAX_POSITION_NOTIONAL_EXCEEDED: ≤ 20% gross concentration cap.
  • DAILY_DRAWDOWN_KILLSWITCH: Fail-closed intraday halt at −3.0% PnL.
  • Ed25519 120s Single-Use Attestation: Canonical SHA-256 order hash with NONCE_ALREADY_SPENT replay rejection, Touch ID passkey approval queue, and SHA-256 hash-chained audit ledger.

Documentation, Audit & Console (v0.8.0)

  • 60-Second Browser-Local Portfolio Audit (/audit)
  • Documentation Overview (/docs)
  • Quickstart (/docs/quickstart)
  • Remote & Local MCP Setup (/docs/mcp)
  • Risk Guardrails & Mandates (/docs/guardrails)
  • Interactive Brokers Setup (/docs/ibkr)
  • Security & Open-Core Boundary (/docs/security)
  • Technical Deep Dive & Threat Model (/docs/deep-dive)
  • ClearFills Cloud Console (/console)
  • Open-Core GitHub Repository (Apache-2.0)

Pricing & Quickstart (v0.8.0)

  • $0 Open Core (Apache-2.0): pip install clearfills. Deterministic Risk Firewall, RFC 8785 canonical hashing, Ed25519 + WebAuthn verifiers, local IBKR clearfills watch worker, Strategy Envelopes, and 500 Cloud checks/mo.
  • $49/mo Builder: Hosted Cloud Console, unlimited firewall checks, Alpaca Paper/Live, multi-account sync, Push/Telegram/Email/SMS/Slack alerts, and treasury/FX/wash-sale mandates.
  • $149/mo HoldCo & Team: Personal + OpCo + HoldCo + Trust multi-entity consolidation, Tax & Compliance Guard Packs, up to 10 sub-desks with scoped agent keys, and tamper-evident CPA audit export.
  • Enterprise VPC ($1,500-$2,500/mo or custom 2-week install): Dedicated Fly.io + Tailscale or AWS Nitro Enclave deployment, KMS/HSM Ed25519 isolation, multi-signer Passkey quorum, and custom SLA.
